chunks.title: Visao Geral
chunks.summary: Introducao ao Core Engine: bug fixes, failsafes, QoL, parametros, UI, shortcut scripts

chunks.title: Requisitos e Compatibilidade

chunks.title: Bug Fixes
chunks.summary: 17+ bugs corrigidos automaticamente pelo Core Engine
chunks.content: Bugs corrigidos: Attack Skill Trait, Auto Battle (skill usage, seal bypass, lock up, attack), Auto Save, Battle Forced End, Debug Console, Gamepad Repeat, Invisible Sprites, Instant Text, Move Picture, Substitute, Skill List, Sprite Removal, Status Window Name, Termination Clear, Timer Sprite, Unusable Items, Water Tile, Window Arrows/Client Area/Skin Bleeding

chunks.title: Failsafes e Scripts
chunks.summary: Protecoes contra crashes em scripts, digit grouping, scroll-linked pictures, show scrolling text como script
chunks.content: Scroll-Linked Pictures, Movement Route Scripts failsafe, Script Call Failsafes, Digit Grouping (locale-aware), Show Scrolling Text como script estendido (>12 linhas)

chunks.content: Max Level/Initial Level para atores, Learn At Level para classes. Permite ultrapassar limite de 99 do editor

chunks.title: Notetags: QoL
chunks.summary: Encounter steps, tile shadows, scroll lock por mapa
chunks.content: Minimum Encounter Steps, Show/Hide Tile Shadows, Scroll Lock X/Y (com e sem nudge)

chunks.title: Notetags: Basic/X/S Parameters

chunks.title: Notetags: JS Parameters

chunks.content: Taller By x: id - Expande tiles por terrain tag. Colocar apenas tile base no mapa. Comportamento varia por priority (O/X/★)

chunks.title: Notetags: Batalha

chunks.content: Forcar battle view (FV/SV), battle system (DTB/TPB Active+Wait/BTB/CTB/ETB/FTB/OTB/PTB/STB), battle grid. Inserir em Map Notetags, Troop Name Tags ou Troop Comment Tags
